title: [BUG] [alpha] monacoManager acquireEditor LRU branch is unreachable
summary: The pool-full LRU reuse block filters !inUse after a prior !inUse search has already failed, making that branch unreachable.
steps: Enter acquireEditor when pool is full.
Observe later LRU branch again requires !inUse via filter(!inUse).
expected: LRU branch should select a reusable editor when pool is full.
actual: LRU candidate is always empty under current path conditions.
